compute_policy: All experiment computation ran in the container; GitHub stores compact reproducibility/results checkpoints.

finite_blackbox_sampling.query: choose two sampled raw input pairs; observe only whether task outputs are equal

committee_query_synthesis.principle: score proposals on a small random committee of surviving sources; evaluate only the chosen query on all survivors
committee_query_synthesis.comparison: candidate-side observation drops from 21.56% of the full 20x1024 table in the full-survivor proposal64 screen to 6.24% while preserving 1000/1000 correctness

continuous_non_enumerable.invariance: preserved under source-specific strictly increasing output reparameterizations
continuous_non_enumerable.bridge: one-bit grounded predicate output > scalar reference r, used only to break monotone-output equivalence

noisy_continuous_unresolved.policy: Bayesian posterior; synthesize posterior-splitting relation/bridge queries; emit a source only at posterior >= 0.999, otherwise UNRESOLVED

interpretation: Query synthesis no longer requires a precomputed finite behavior table. A small source committee can propose informative black-box experiments; the same principle extends to a continuous non-enumerable input domain using order relations. Under noisy observations, calibrated UNRESOLVED trades coverage for zero observed wrong routing in these screens.
claim_boundaries: finite 20-source experiment still has a known random input generator
continuous order relation is invariant to strictly monotone output transforms, not arbitrary output bijections
a small grounded cross-modal bridge remains necessary for residual output-reparameterization equivalence
Bayesian noise screen assumes the observation bit-flip rate is known and candidate source characterization is stable
next: infer/calibrate observation noise online instead of assuming a known bit-flip rate
replace random proposal sampling with learned continuous query optimization while preserving black-box constraints
integrate black-box query synthesis with private-ABI neural sources and learned stream execution
